entries.title: Canonical 66-Soul Registry Sync & Public Game Data API
entries.summary: Unified the official SoulspireXI website and Wiki onto a single canonical game-data pipeline powered by the centralized 66-Soul registry.

changes.text: Synchronized all 66 canonical Soul names, 3-letter abbreviations, roles, abilities, spells, traits, and lore across soulspirexi.com and wiki.soulspirexi.com.
Launched the versioned public read-only Game Data API (/api/v1/) with automatic legacy URL redirects for renamed Souls.
Added live feature availability tracking clearly separating currently deployed gameplay systems from upcoming updates.

entries.title: Public Alpha Invite Registration & Encyclopedia Refresh
entries.summary: Opened invite-only Public Alpha registration on soulspirexi.com/register and refreshed all 66 player-facing Soul guides.

changes.text: Published the invite-only Create Account portal for Public Alpha testers.
Updated player-facing guides for all 66 Souls to focus cleanly on playstyles, synergies, cooldowns, and tactical decision-making.

entries.title: Soul Weapon Configuration System & Launcher v2.1.0
entries.summary: Introduced Soul-specific weapon configuration rules alongside SoulspireLauncher v2.1.0.

changes.text: Added the Soul Weapon Configuration System, enabling dual one-handed weapon wielding for Bard Skald.
Released SoulspireLauncher v2.1.0 with transactional updates, update channels, and the Sundered Crag visual identity.

entries.title: All 66 Canonical Souls, 219 WS Talent Trees & Burrows Reborn
entries.summary: Completed the full 66-Soul roster across all 22 classic FFXI jobs alongside 219 bespoke Weaponskill Talent Trees and the Lv. 10 Burrows Reborn encounter.

changes.text: Expanded the roster to all 66 playable Soul Crystals across all 22 classic jobs (3 Souls per job).
Launched 219 spec-adaptive Weaponskill Talent Trees spanning Tier 1 through Tier 4 capstones.
Introduced Burrows Reborn: The First Descent, an early-game Lv. 10 instanced encounter.
